name: Master & Slave ~Goshujin-sama to Mesu Dorei~
original_name: Master & Slave～御主人様と雌奴隷～
source:
In medieval world people start studying magic. In remote forests of a kingdom there is an educational facility for girls practicing magic. Main character holds a laboratory there, but he has a reputation of a sadist, so students avoid it. This year there are four girls who enroll to the laboratory. It becomes a great surprise for protagonist. Well, now time's for fun.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在一个刚开始研究魔法的中世纪世界。王国偏远森林中有一所培养女性魔法师的教育机构，主人公在那里经营一间研究室。不过，他以施虐成性而闻名，学生们都对研究室避之不及。

今年，竟有四名少女选择加入这里，令主人公大感意外。那么，现在该享受一番了。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
